description: Query of `GET /mgmt/v1/people/{external_id}/notifications`: long-poll after a member seq.

after.description: Return items with `seq > after`. K2 sends the previous page's `next`.

limit.description: At most this many items (1–500, default 100).

wait.description: Long-poll up to this many seconds while there is nothing to return (0–30, default 0).

title: PersonNotificationsQuery
